slides.headline: BUSINESS CONSULTANTS CHARGE $150 AN HOUR FOR THESE 6 PROMPTS, CLAUDE BUILDS EVERY ONE FREE IN MINUTES
1) WRITE AN SOP FOR ANY TASK IN YOUR BUSINESS
slides.body: Business process consultants charge $150 an hour to document this. Claude does it in 4 minutes: "[Task]: Write an SOP for a new hire. Include what to do if something goes wrong."

slides.headline: 2) TURN YOUR TEAM'S QUESTIONS INTO A TRAINING GUIDE
slides.body:
Every question your team still asks you is a missing system. This prompt fixes that:

"Here are the 10 questions my team asks me most: [list them]. Write a training guide answering every one."

slides.headline: 3) BUILD A HIRING SCORECARD THAT FILTERS OUT BAD HIRES
slides.body: The U.S. Department of Labor puts a bad hire at 30% of first-year salary, $15,000 on a $50,000 role: "Hire a [role]. Build a 10-question scorecard with strong and red-flag answers."

slides.headline: 4) DELEGATE A WHOLE JOB WITHOUT LOSING CONTROL
slides.body:
Most owners never delegate because explaining it takes longer than doing it. Use this prompt:

"I want to delegate [task]. List every decision they need to make and the rule to follow each time."

slides.headline: 5) BUILD YOUR WHOLE CLIENT ONBOARDING IN ONE SESSION
slides.body:
If the owner must touch every new client, the business cannot grow. This prompt removes that:

"After a client signs: [walk through each step]. Turn this into a checklist any team member can follow."

slides.headline: 6) FIND YOUR BUSINESS'S SINGLE POINTS OF FAILURE
slides.body:
Most owners only learn their business is fragile on vacation. Map it first:

"[Business type], [X] employees. List every process that breaks if I disappear for 30 days. Rate the damage 1 to 10."

slides.headline: SAVE THIS
slides.body: You will want these prompts the next time you are buried in work and cannot see a way out. Daily AI news and real skills for business owners. That is all we post.

caption:

The business owners winning with AI right now are not using it to write emails. They are using it to build systems that run without them. That shift is happening whether you are in it or not. Running a business? DM us 'AI' and we will show you what this could do for yours.
